notes: Eight own pages read, all HTTP 200 and not thin; the URL pci-gdpr-hotel-management-software.html renders the Deployment Options text, not a security page. No claim is wrong or stale, so no cited page was read for causes. Maestro publishes no prices, so the custom pricing, $25,000 license and no-trial claims are unverifiable. C10 (about 89 verified integrations) is unverifiable rather than wrong: the vendor publishes over 800 vendor integrations (and a press headline cites 600+ supported interfaces), while the answer reports a third-party verified-integrations count; a reviewer may prefer wrong. C04 (over 40 years) is true as a lower bound of the published over 43 years. The claim that Maestro is the only PMS company with this deployment choice is a comparison and was not coded; module lists (sales and catering, spa, condo owner) and the 20+ module count are feature descriptions and were not coded. Platform deployment options were coded one claim per option (cloud, on-premise, private cloud, web browser, Windows, mobile apps, tablet). Pass 2 (8 Oct 2026): no browser reads exist for this vendor and no claim was blocked by an unreadable page, so nothing was re-classed. Gap lines were all feature descriptions, positioning or about other vendors; open API mentions name no third-party product and were not coded. Comparison tables with Maestro as a column header added instances: q8 ChatGPT run 3 deployment row to C11, C12, C14 and C15; mobile guest tools and the Mobile Access row to C16. No claim is wrong or stale, so the consistency check changed nothing.
